title: AgentSupply
description: Per-backend supply strategy & status (spec §4.2, frames V6 01–04 / M01–M02). v2: this record OWNS the spend order. Ordering is a consumption property — each backend keeps its own ordered subset of the sources it is eligible for. There is no global priority list.

mode.description: 中枢/直连. Existing users stay direct until they migrate; fresh installs default hub (plan §4). Under Option 1, hub mode for claude still consumes the subscription via the native channel per turn.

current.description: What the next turn would use (frame V6 01 supply row) — i.e. the first runnable candidate in this backend's chain for the selected model. NULL IN THREE CASES, not one: (a) mode=direct; (b) `supply_status: "waiting"` — every candidate is cooling; (c) `supply_status: "interrupted"` — no candidate can recover unattended. In (b) and (c) the serializer MUST emit null rather than the last-used source: a stale `current` would render 使用中 for a source that will not be called, which is exactly the lie the taxonomy exists to prevent. Non-null ⇒ `supply_status` is ok or degraded.

model_id.description: The RESOLVED upstream model id, mapping applied — what actually gets sent (e.g. `glm-5.2`). NOT a valid input to the chain query or the probe: for open-menu backends the caller-facing identifier is prefixed (`zhipuai/glm-5.2`), so passing this value through would miss. Use `menu_model_id` for that.

menu_model_id.description: v2 (2026-07-29): the same selection expressed as the CALLER-FACING menu identifier — the built-in id for fixed menus, the prefixed vendor/model id for open menus. Exists because the two namespaces genuinely differ for OpenCode, and every consumer that has to talk back to the server (chain query, probe default, menu highlight) needs this one, not `model_id`. null is permitted only when it is byte-identical to `model_id`; open-menu backends must always populate it. OPTIONAL here / required at the API boundary once the serializer emits it (README → required-vs-optional).

sources.description: v2 (2026-07-29): this backend's source order — the ordered SUBSET of sources it spends, plus the policy that governs the order (spec §4.2). Replaces v1's global priority.schema.json. Optional in this schema only because the shipped v1 serializer predates it; it becomes REQUIRED at the API boundary in the serializer PR that lands per-agent ordering (README → Required-vs-optional). null while mode=direct.

policy.description: follow = 跟随推荐 (default): the server computes `order` from the recommendation rule (spec §4.2 — the backend's own native subscription first, then api_key sources by creation time ascending) and newly added eligible sources join automatically. custom = 自定义: a user-owned frozen subset; new sources do NOT join and the UI hints 「有新来源未启用」. Any manual edit while in follow forks the record to custom; 「恢复推荐顺序」 returns it to follow. The server never reorders a custom list (spec §2 promise 4).

order.description: Enabled source ids, position 0 = spend first. A SUBSET, not a permutation: sources this backend is ineligible for, or that the user removed, are absent. Authoritative — the server always re-echoes the full canonical order after any mutation; clients never compute partial reorders.

eligibility.description: v2: server-authoritative eligibility, one entry per existing source (spec §4.4). Exists so the UI chokepoint isSourceEligible (ui/src/components/settings/models/menus/identifiers.ts, self-documented as ESCALATED) becomes a pure projection instead of a second hand-written copy of the compatibility matrix. Drives the 未启用 / 不适用 sections of the agent drawer.

reason_key.description: i18n key explaining an ineligible source (e.g. models.eligibility.subscription_wrong_client, models.eligibility.opencode_api_key_only, models.eligibility.consent_required). null when eligible.

supply_status.description: v2: derived per-agent health rollup (spec §4.5), computed per request and never persisted. Split on the SAME question as source status — does it heal itself: ok = serving from the intended head of the chain; degraded = serving via a fallback and/or some chain members are down (still running); waiting = nothing runnable right now but every blocker is a cooldown, so it recovers unattended at the earliest `retry_at` (UI: 「暂时全部在冷却」, feed only, NEVER an IM push); interrupted = nothing runnable and at least one blocker needs the user (needs_action / error), or the capability chain is structurally EMPTY (UI: 「当前无可用来源」, `severity: action_required`, proactive push). waiting exists precisely so an all-cooling agent does not trip the push path — pushing there would contradict the rule that self-healing states never interrupt the user. interrupted is otherwise the state v1 could not express: a populated source list while this particular agent has nothing to call. null when mode=direct.

mappings.description: fixed-menu backends only; per-agent scope (spec §4.3 step 1). Absent entry = 跟随原生 (identity). A mapping chooses a MODEL, never a source.

builtin_id.description: real built-in model id, e.g. claude-opus-4-6

model_supply.description: v2: cheap per-menu-item chain summary so the 模型菜单 drawer can flag 「无来源可供」 without one chain query per row (spec §4.6). Read-only projection; the authoritative chain is GET /api/models/agents/<backend>/chain.

model_id.description: The identifier this backend's menu uses: the built-in id for fixed menus, the prefixed identifier (vendor/model) for open menus.

chain_length.description: Length of the CAPABILITY chain — how many sources in this backend's order can supply this model at all, mapping applied — matching `AgentChain.chain`, cooling members included. Deliberately NOT a count of currently-runnable candidates: this drives a menu row's 「无来源可供」 flag, which is a structural fact about the model, and it must not flicker because an account is mid-cooldown. 0 ⇒ flag the row; transient unavailability is `supply_status` (waiting) instead.

builtin_models.description: v1.2 (2026-07-24 integration): fixed-menu backends only — real built-in model ids, server-populated from vibe/backend_model_catalog.py; null for open-menu backends. UI must not hardcode menus.

standard_vendors.description: v1.2 (2026-07-24 integration): opencode only — server-populated mirror of STANDARD_OPENCODE_VENDOR_IDS (core/handlers/model_hub/identifiers.py) so the UI never hand-mirrors vendor lists; null otherwise.
